verses.1: To David, the prophet said, “In his heart, there is no God. They have been destroyed and ruined. There is no one who does good.”
verses.2: The LORD from heaven looks down upon mankind, to see whether there is anyone who is wise and seeks after God.
verses.3: Everything is ruined together; no one does anything good. There’s not even a single person who does anything right.
verses.4: They did not know that all those who ate from the offerings of my people ate bread given by Jehovah. They did not call out for help.
verses.5: There, they were filled with fear, because God was in the midst of the wicked.
verses.6: The advice of the poor will be despised, because Jehovah will protect them.
verses.7: Who will give Israel salvation again, when Jehovah brings his people back? Jacob will rejoice, and Israel will be happy.
